_comment: Shared test vectors (root CLAUDE.md 5.9). Python (ml/tests) and Kotlin (android) test against this file. expected_normalized and expected_fingerprint are generated by ml/src/features/vectors/fill_derived.py. expected_score_min/max are PROVISIONAL (by label) until the model export (step 5) regenerates them. expected_label is SAFE, CAUTION or SCAM. Personal numbers are 2547XXXXXXXX placeholders in the 254700000xxx range; sender_in_contacts is absent when unknown.
